task: Use the image_generate tool to create an image of 'a small terracotta-roofed coastal town at golden hour, seen from a boat on the water, warm orange and pink sky, no people visible'. After generation, report the saved file path and confirm the image was actually produced (non-empty file).
rubric: A vision-capable judge must open the generated image file and score 0-1 on: (a) the image plausibly depicts a coastal town with terracotta roofs, not an unrelated subject; (b) the lighting is warm/golden-hour toned (orange/pink), not midday or night; (c) no people are prominently visible in the frame; (d) the agent actually called image_generate and reported a real saved file path rather than describing an image without generating one.
